public_rationale: The study reports the contrast Marcus describes: strongly negative associations triggered by African American English alongside substantially more favorable overt associations. This supports his summary when 'fine' describes the overall overt results rather than complete freedom from bias.
limitations: The verdict depends on a qualified reading of 'fine'; the study does not certify every model or output as unbiased.
The evidence concerns the tested models and association measures, not all LLMs or all real-world interactions.
The cited peer-reviewed publication appeared after the post, but the original preprint was checked for the same finding.
